Person.title: Person

email.description: Primary email (convenience field, full contacts via ContactDetail)

nationality.description: Corporate-governance extension (beyond Popolo): officeholder nationality, surfaced in mode=corp

Post.title: Post
Post.description: A formal position within a governance body that can be filled by a person via Membership. Popolo: Post. Examples: Chair, Secretary, Treasurer.

Membership.title: Membership
Membership.description: Relationship between a person and an organization, including role and time bounds. Popolo: Membership. Replaces the role field on Participant — a person can have multiple memberships in different governance bodies.

label.description: Descriptive label for the membership (carries corporate-governance wording in mode=corp, e.g. 'Voorzitter RvC')

endDate.description: When the membership ended, null if active (Popolo: end_date)

votingWeight.description: Vote weight for this membership, default 1

independenceStatus.description: Corporate-governance extension (beyond Popolo, MCCG): board-member independence, mode=corp

otherPositions.description: Corporate-governance extension (beyond Popolo): nevenfuncties / other positions, mode=corp

ContactDetail.title: ContactDetail
ContactDetail.description: A means of contacting a person or organization. Popolo: ContactDetail. Replaces the single email field on Participant with typed, multi-value contacts.

value.description: Contact value e.g. email address (Popolo: value)

GovernanceBody.title: GovernanceBody
GovernanceBody.description: A governance body (council, board, committee, assembly)

hourlyRate.description: Average hourly rate in EUR per attendee, used by the meeting cost calculator (meeting-efficiency). Schema.org MonetaryAmount value; currency is EUR.

Meeting.title: Meeting
Meeting.description: A scheduled governance meeting with agenda, participants, and lifecycle

seriesPattern.description: Recurrence pattern stored on the series template meeting (meeting-series REQ-MSR-001). Expanded into individual meeting instances by MeetingSeriesService.

interval.description: Step between occurrences in frequency units (>= 1)

until.description: Inclusive end date of the series

exceptions.description: Dates (Y-m-d) on which no instance is generated

eventAttendanceMode.description: Schema.org attendance mode of the event (offline / online / mixed)

virtualLocation.description: Video conference / virtual participation URL for online and hybrid meetings

chair.description: UUID of the Participant who chairs this meeting. Resolved to the Participant record in MCP and minutes generation; the chair field on the Participant (role=chair) applies to the governance body broadly, while this field overrides the chair for this specific meeting.

isPublic.description: Whether this meeting is visible to citizens in the public transparency portal (p3-citizen-participation). When true, the agenda (if published), recordings, and approved minutes become visible to unauthenticated users.

submissionDeadline.description: Deadline for submitting motions and amendments for this meeting (motion-amendment spec). Empty = no deadline. Motion/amendment creations after this moment are rejected server-side by the SubmissionDeadlineListener.

openedAt.description: Timestamp of the first 'open' lifecycle transition, stamped server-side by MeetingService (meeting-efficiency). Basis for the live cost calculator and duration analytics.

closedAt.description: Timestamp of the 'close' lifecycle transition, stamped server-side by MeetingService (meeting-efficiency).

meetingCost.description: Total meeting cost in EUR, computed server-side on close from elapsed time x attendee count x the governance body's hourlyRate (meeting-efficiency). Schema.org MonetaryAmount value.

Participant.title: Participant
Participant.description: DEPRECATED: superseded by Person + Membership (ADR-001 §2); retained as a shim for quorum aggregation + vote-casting resolver until the retire-participant-shim follow-up. A member or attendee of a governance body.

nextcloudUserId.description: The Nextcloud user ID (login name / UID) of the Nextcloud user who represents this participant. Used by VotingService::resolveParticipantUuid() to find the Participant record for the currently logged-in user, enabling vote-casting, proxy delegation, and vote-link personalisation. Must be set when the participant has a corresponding Nextcloud account.

attendanceStatus.description: Attendance status for the current or most recent meeting

participantType.description: Attendance mode for the current or most recent meeting — stamped on votes as castAs (remote-vote session annotation, voting-system spec).

AgendaItem.title: AgendaItem
AgendaItem.description: An item on a meeting agenda with type, time, and ordering

pausedDuration.description: Minutes the agenda-item timer was paused for procedural interruptions, recorded separately from actualDuration (meeting-efficiency)

parentItem.description: UUID of the parent AgendaItem when this item is a nested sub-item (e.g. committee reports grouped under one heading). Null/absent for top-level items.

VotingRound.title: VotingRound
VotingRound.description: A voting session on a motion or amendment

votingDeadline.description: Optional deadline by which votes must be cast. Drives the 24-hour pre-deadline reminder notification (nextcloud-integration spec).

deadlineReminderSentAt.description: Server-side marker set when the 24-hour deadline reminder has been sent (prevents duplicate reminders).

voteThreshold.description: Majority rule applied when tallying this round (mirrors Resolution.voteThreshold). Default simple-majority.

abstentionHandling.description: Whether abstentions are excluded from the calculation base (default) or counted toward it, making thresholds harder.

tieBreakRule.description: Configured tie-breaking rule for a simple-majority tie: rejected (default, motion fails), chair-decides (chair resolves via casting vote), or revote (round may be reopened once).

chairCastingVote.description: The chair's explicit casting vote resolving a tie under tieBreakRule=chair-decides (audit trail).

revoteOfRound.description: UUID of the tied round this round is the single permitted revote of (tieBreakRule=revote).

voteBase.description: Computed calculation base the threshold was evaluated against at tally time (for+against, plus abstentions under abstentionHandling=count).

Vote.title: Vote
Vote.description: An individual vote cast in a voting round

castAs.description: Honest recording of the caster's attendance mode at cast time (from Participant.participantType; unknown when unresolvable). No session verification is performed.

Decision.title: Decision
Decision.description: The universal governance-decision supertype (ADR-005). A single schema for every decision outcome — motion, amendment, resolution, contract, appointment, management point, policy and generic meeting outcome — distinguished by the required decisionType discriminator. Type-specific fields are folded in and revealed via progressive disclosure keyed on decisionType (ADR-006).

x-openregister.x-mail-security-audit: mailEnabled activates inbound email ingestion. Before production: verify OpenRegister sanitizes HTML/headers, validate sender identity, and ensure Decision views never use v-html for mail-sourced content. Tracked in issue #6.

decisionType.description: Discriminator selecting the kind of governance decision (ADR-005). Drives progressive disclosure of the type-specific field groups in the form. Per-type required fields (e.g. proposer for motion; resolutionNumber + voteThreshold for resolution; the amends relation for amendment) are enforced in the form/spec, not in this JSON-schema required[].

isPublished.description: Publication state controlling citizen visibility (p3-citizen-participation). 'internal' = staff-only; 'public' = visible in transparency portal and ORI API; 'confidential' = restricted access.

lifecycle.description: Decision state-machine lifecycle (guarded transition map: draft → proposed → deliberating → voting → decided → enacted → archived, plus a terminal 'withdrawn' reachable from any non-terminal state before 'enacted'). The declarative transition map lives in x-openregister-lifecycle. Orthogonal to 'outcome' (the voting result, set when reaching 'decided') and 'isPublished' (citizen visibility of the record, p3-citizen-participation).

enactedAt.description: Timestamp when the decision entered the 'enacted' lifecycle state (set server-side by the enact transition).

motionType.description: Revealed when decisionType=motion. Type of motion (folded from the retired Motion schema).

proposer.description: Revealed when decisionType is motion, amendment or resolution. Name of the proposer (folded from Motion/Amendment/Resolution). Required for a motion decision (enforced in the form).

coSigners.description: Revealed when decisionType=motion. List of co-signers (folded from the retired Motion schema).

submittedAt.description: Revealed when decisionType is motion or amendment. Submission timestamp (folded from Motion/Amendment).

citizenVotingAllowed.description: Revealed when decisionType=motion. Whether citizens can participate in voting on this decision (p3-citizen-participation, folded from the retired Motion schema).

citizenVotingMethod.description: Revealed when decisionType=motion. Voting method rendered in the citizen voting UI (folded from the retired Motion schema). Only meaningful when citizenVotingAllowed is true.

proposedText.description: Revealed when decisionType=amendment. Full proposed replacement text for the affected passage, diffed against the parent decision text in the amendment diff view (folded from the retired Amendment schema).

votingOrder.description: Revealed when decisionType=amendment. Chair-assigned voting position among a motion's amendments (1 = voted first, most far-reaching). Folded from the retired Amendment schema.

resolutionNumber.description: Revealed when decisionType=resolution. Resolution number, format R-{year}-{seq} (folded from the retired Resolution schema). Required for a resolution decision (enforced in the form).

resolutionType.description: Revealed when decisionType=resolution. Resolution classification (renamed from Resolution.type to avoid collision with decisionType; folded from the retired Resolution schema).

voteType.description: Revealed when decisionType=resolution. How the vote was conducted (folded from the retired Resolution schema).

voteThreshold.description: Revealed when decisionType=resolution. Majority rule applied when tallying (folded from the retired Resolution schema). Required for a resolution decision (enforced in the form).

fullText.description: Revealed when decisionType=resolution. Full resolution text (rich-text / HTML; folded from the retired Resolution schema).

background.description: Revealed when decisionType=resolution. Background / motivation (rich-text; folded from the retired Resolution schema).

adoptionDate.description: Revealed when decisionType=resolution. Date the resolution was adopted (folded from the retired Resolution schema).

effectiveDate.description: Revealed when decisionType=resolution. Date the resolution takes effect (folded from the retired Resolution schema).

x-openregister-lifecycle._note: Declarative guarded transition map (ADR-031). The proven 7-state flow draft → proposed → deliberating → voting → decided → enacted → archived is retained from decision-state-machine-v1; a terminal 'withdrawn' state is added, reachable from any non-terminal state before 'enacted' (design D2 + resolved deferred question). lifecycle is orthogonal to 'outcome' (voting result) and 'isPublished' (citizen visibility).

amends.description: Used by decisionType=amendment to point at its parent motion decision (replaces the retired Amendment → Motion relation).

offer.description: Contract attachment: offers/quotes related to a decisionType=contract decision (ADR-005).

order.description: Contract attachment: purchase orders related to a decisionType=contract decision (ADR-005).

product.description: Contract attachment: products/services related to a decisionType=contract decision (ADR-005).

agendaItem.description: UUID of the agenda item the notes belong to

notes.description: Discussion notes for the agenda item

decisions.description: Decisions recorded for the agenda item

corrections.description: Correction suggestions submitted by meeting participants during review (minutes-ui-v1)

authorName.description: Display name of the suggesting participant

resolvedBy.description: Nextcloud UID of the chair/secretary who resolved the suggestion

path.description: Path of the persisted file in the OpenRegister Files storage

docudesk.description: Whether Docudesk rendered the document (false = markdown fallback)

Order.title: Order
Order.description: Schema.org Order for purchase order data

CitizenVote.title: CitizenVote
CitizenVote.description: A vote cast by a citizen on a motion that has citizenVotingAllowed enabled (p3-citizen-participation). Distinct from staff Vote entities tied to a VotingRound — citizen votes may be participatory or advisory and are tallied separately.

voteValue.description: Citizen vote value. For simple voting a string ('voor' | 'tegen' | 'onthoud'); for ranked voting an ordered array of option identifiers; for weighted voting a numeric weight or weight-map serialised as string.

voterId.description: Stable identifier for the citizen voter (Nextcloud UID or pseudonymous hash for anonymous referenda).

motionId.description: UUID of the Motion this vote applies to.

citizenPanelId.description: Optional UUID of the CitizenPanel the voter represents; omitted for individual citizen votes.

weight.description: Vote weight (for weighted voting; defaults to 1 for simple voting).

notes.description: Optional citizen-supplied reasoning attached to the vote (may be published with consent).

CitizenPanel.title: CitizenPanel
CitizenPanel.description: A structured citizen advisory group with defined membership, term, and scope (p3-citizen-participation). Modelled as schema:Organization with classification 'citizen-panel' per Popolo.

description.description: Public description of the panel's purpose and remit.

memberCount.description: Current number of confirmed panel members.

createdBy.description: Nextcloud UID of the staff member who created the panel.

ParticipatoryBudget.title: ParticipatoryBudget
ParticipatoryBudget.description: A participatory budgeting round in which citizens propose projects and allocate funds (p3-citizen-participation). Modelled as schema:Grant for compatibility with funding-transparency vocabularies.

description.description: Public description of the budget round.

votingDeadline.description: Deadline for citizens to vote on proposals.

resultsPublished.description: Whether final allocation results are visible to citizens.

subject.en: Budget proposal '{{title}}' voting deadline is approaching

BudgetProposal.title: BudgetProposal
BudgetProposal.description: A project proposed for funding under a ParticipatoryBudget (p3-citizen-participation).

submitter.description: Nextcloud UID or pseudonymous identifier of the citizen submitter.

PublicConsultation.title: PublicConsultation
PublicConsultation.description: A formal citizen consultation round attached to a decision, motion, or policy (p3-citizen-participation).

description.description: Public description of the consultation purpose and process.

relatedDecision.description: Optional UUID of the related Decision.

submissionDeadline.description: Deadline for citizens to submit feedback.

feedbackRequired.description: Whether feedback is mandatory before the consultation can close.

Deliberation.title: Deliberation
Deliberation.description: A threaded discussion forum container linked to a motion or topic for structured citizen deliberation (p3-citizen-participation). Individual posts are conceptually schema:DiscussionForumPosting children stored as related objects.

relatedMotion.description: Optional UUID of the Motion under deliberation.

moderator.description: Nextcloud UID of the staff moderator.

postsCount.description: Number of posts in the thread.

Notification.title: Notification
Notification.description: A citizen-facing notification delivered via email, SMS, or in-app channel (p3-citizen-participation). Tracks delivery state and read state for preference-aware batching.

recipientId.description: Nextcloud UID or stable pseudonymous identifier of the recipient.

subject.description: Short subject line for email or push delivery.

content.description: Notification body (plain text or localised key).

readAt.description: When the citizen read the in-app notification.

NotificationPreference.title: NotificationPreference
NotificationPreference.description: Per-user personal preferences for Decidesk (user-settings spec): notification event toggles + delivery channels, meeting-reminder timing, absence delegation (delegate + period, automatic expiry by date comparison), and governance communication preferences. One object per person; reads/writes are scoped to the session user by NotificationPreferenceController.

person.description: Nextcloud UID (or participant UUID) of the user these preferences belong to.

meetingCreated.description: Notify when a meeting is scheduled.

votingOpened.description: Notify when a vote is pending (voting round opened).

decisionPublished.description: Notify when a decision is published.

taskAssigned.description: Notify when an action item is assigned.

commentMention.description: Notify when mentioned in a comment.

meetingReminder.description: Send Decidesk meeting reminders (calendar reminders are independent).

reminderTimes.description: When to send meeting reminders before the meeting starts. Default: 24 hours and 1 hour before.

delegate.description: Nextcloud UID of the delegate who receives this user's notifications during the absence period. Delegation never grants voting rights (a formal proxy/volmacht is required for voting).

delegationFrom.description: First day (inclusive) of the absence delegation period.

delegationUntil.description: Last day (inclusive) of the absence delegation period; the delegation expires automatically after this date.

governanceEmail.description: Preferred e-mail address for governance communications (convocations, minutes, reminders). Empty = Nextcloud account email.

urgentPhone.description: Phone number for urgent governance matters (stored for secretariat use).

communicationLanguage.description: Preferred language for governance communications. Empty = Nextcloud locale.

EngagementRecord.title: EngagementRecord
EngagementRecord.description: A record of participant engagement during a meeting — speeches, questions raised, and topics suggested

meeting.description: UUID of the linked Meeting object

participant.description: UUID of the linked Participant object

speeches.description: Speech events recorded for this participant

engagementScore.description: Governance-specific engagement score (0–100), computed in-app by EngagementService.calculateScore() and stored on each capture

speechCount.description: Number of speech events (generic count fed to the analytics leaf)

questionCount.description: Number of questions raised (generic count fed to the analytics leaf)

topicCount.description: Number of topics suggested (generic count fed to the analytics leaf)

Board.title: Board
Board.description: A governance board (Raad van Commissarissen, Raad van Bestuur, audit committee, etc.) per MCCG / Dutch Civil Code Book 2

governanceModel.description: Two-tier (RvC + RvB) or one-tier (combined) board model

quorumRule.description: Quorum rule expression (e.g. 'half-plus-one', 'two-thirds', or numeric integer)

noticeDeadlineDays.description: Required notice period for regular meetings in calendar days

materialRetentionDays.description: How long board materials remain accessible after the meeting

nevenfuncties.description: Disclosed side-positions (nevenfuncties) per Dutch Civil Code disclosure obligation

BoardMeeting.title: BoardMeeting

recipient.description: UUID of the BoardMember the notice was sent to

displayName.description: Display name of the recipient at send time

role.description: Board role of the recipient at send time

caldavUid.description: CalDAV VEVENT UID for syncing to attendee calendars

BoardVote.title: BoardVote
BoardVote.description: An individual board-member vote on a Resolution, with proxy / abstention metadata

proxyHolder.description: BoardMember UUID of the proxy holder, if vote-method=proxy

BoardMinutes.title: BoardMinutes
BoardMinutes.description: Signed minutes of a board meeting with eIDAS signature metadata + multilingual reconciliation

pdfArchiveReference.description: Reference to the archived PDF/A-3 in Nextcloud Files

hashSha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical PDF for tamper detection

reconciliationNotes.description: Reconciliation notes for multilingual minutes pair drift

ConflictOfInterest.title: ConflictOfInterest
ConflictOfInterest.description: A declared or detected conflict-of-interest disclosure per MCCG / governance code

agendaItem.description: Optional UUID of the agenda item / resolution

BoardMaterial.title: BoardMaterial
BoardMaterial.description: A board document with access-level + watermark metadata; backing document handle lives in docudesk

documentReference.description: Reference to the underlying document (e.g. docudesk handle or Nextcloud file path)

BoardAuditLogEntry.title: BoardAuditLogEntry
BoardAuditLogEntry.description: Append-only, hash-chained audit log entry for board portal actions (votes, signatures, access)

actor.description: UUID of the acting BoardMember or system user

previousHash.description: SHA-256 of the previous audit-log entry (hash chain)

currentHash.description: SHA-256 of this entry's canonical serialization

immutableBlob.description: Full canonical serialization (JSON) for forensic-grade audit
